svg.text: SHEET 2 - LOGIC: ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1, PCA9685, USB-C HEAD port (OTG host), sense dividers, UI
up the column to the phone
GPIO0 has the DevKit's 10k pull-up + BOOT sw.
v1.1 boards use GPIO38 - set in firmware)
fitted at the A2 V+ terminal (senses the load)
9.0 V -> 1.62 V; full scale ~17 V; on PB
Breakout I2C pull-ups (10k) to VCC=3V3 are sufficient
at 400 kHz with a < 20 cm harness.
USB host port (native OTG, full-speed 12 Mb/s)
ESP32-S3 is USB HOST; phone = device -> AOA accessory.
Rp 22k on CC1/CC2 to VBUS_HEAD advertises 1.5 A and
disappears with VBUS, so phone_power off = clean detach.
GPIO19/20 are also on the DevKit 'USB' connector:
never plug anything into that port while J2 is in use.
Keep D+/D- a twisted pair, < 15 cm to J2, 90 ohm diff.
